title: Mauryan Period
subject: History (CDS/NDA)

blocks.heading: 🛡️ The Mauryan Empire (322 - 185 BCE)
blocks.intro: India's first historical empire, establishing central control over most of the subcontinent.

blocks.heading: 1. Rulers & Triumphs
bullets: Chandragupta Maurya (322 - 298 BCE): Overthrew Dhana Nanda with Chanakya's guidance. Defeated Seleucus Nicator (305 BCE), acquiring Baluchistan and Afghanistan. Megasthenes visited his court. Adopted Jainism under Bhadrabahu and died via *Sallekhana* (fasting) at Shravanabelagola.
Bindusara (298 - 273 BCE): Called *Amitraghata* (slayer of enemies). Received ambassadors from Syria (Deimachus) and Egypt (Dionysius). Patronised the Ajivika sect.

Ashoka (273 - 232 BCE): Coronation in 269 BCE. Kalinga War (261 BCE, detailed in **Major Rock Edict XIII**) caused immense casualties, prompting Ashoka to abandon war (*Bherighosha*) and adopt Dhamma (*Dhammaghosha*). Sent Buddhist missions to Sri Lanka (Mahinda/Sanghamitta).

blocks.heading: 2. Ashokan Edicts & Dhamma
bullets: Edicts are classified into Major Rock Edicts (14), Minor Rock Edicts, Major Pillar Edicts (7), and Cave Inscriptions. Written mostly in Prakrit (Brahmi script).
**Major Rock Edict XIII:** Mentions Kalinga War and contemporary Hellenic kings (Antiochus, Ptolemy).
**Rummindei Pillar Inscription:** Marks Buddha's birthplace (Lumbini) and records Ashoka reducing land tax (*Bhaga*) to 1/8th.

blocks.heading: 3. Administration & Economy
bullets: Highly centralized bureaucracy. King assisted by *Mantriparishad*. 7 limbs of state defined in Kautilya's **Saptanga Theory** (Swami, Amatya, Janapada, Durga, Kosha, Danda, Mitra).
Spy network of *Gudhapurushas* (Sanstha - stationary, Sanchari - wandering).
Tax: Land revenue (*Bhaga*) was usually 1/6th of produce. Punched-marked silver coins (*Panas*) were widely circulated.

formulas: Kalinga War: 261 BCE | Chanakya: Arthashastra | Megasthenes: Indica
